verdict.rationale: The evidence shows agent permission profiles (file access, command execution, directory permissions), action approvals, and cloud agents running on Warp's or your own infrastructure. None of these is a documented sandbox or isolated test environment that keeps agents away from production data. Permission controls and human approval are adjacent safeguards, not sandbox isolation, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
